purpose: Compose translation mounts, center-to-center distance joints and slack center-distance limits around one shared donor-core integration step, with bounded convergence-aware early exit so already-satisfied constraint passes do not consume the full configured budget.

properties.options: bounded family pass counts, bounded per-family position/velocity iteration counts, optional early-exit enablement, and explicit position/velocity convergence tolerances

contains: bounded pass summaries with convergence evidence
configured versus executed pass counts and avoided-pass accounting

relationships.basis: The imported donor source remains unchanged; the composer performs one donor-core integration between additive pre- and post-constraint stages.

limitations: supports only the existing translation-mount, center-to-center distance-joint and center-distance-limit families
distance-limit range interiors remain intentionally slack and do not become exact joints inside the composer
fixed deterministic family order introduces ordering bias
conflicting constraints are bounded by pass counts and are not claimed to converge globally
early exit means only that measured position and constrained relative-velocity residuals satisfied configured thresholds at a pass boundary; it is not proof of equilibrium or global convergence
no angular inertia or rotating local anchors
no hinge, slider, weld, motor or gear constraints
connected constrained bodies can still collide unless caller filters or the component-isolation wrapper suppress that component
post-core projection can move bodies after donor-core contact evidence was generated

proves: translation mounts, exact distance joints and slack distance limits share one donor-core integration per composed step
post-core mixed-family stabilization repairs gravity-induced drift and active limit violations
slack distance-limit interiors preserve unconstrained motion
family passes and nested solver iterations remain bounded
already-satisfied constraints deterministically stop after one pass when early exit is enabled
disabling early exit executes the full bounded pass budget and preserves the same settled final state
conflicting constraints consume their configured pass budget instead of being falsely reported as converged
position and constrained relative-velocity residuals are both visible in convergence evidence
core-stage contact evidence remains separately inspectable

truth.basis: The composer preserves slack distance-limit semantics and names its fixed ordering bias, bounded convergence limits, tolerance-based early-exit meaning and core-stage contact evidence boundary rather than presenting composition as a complete rigid-body solver.

agency.basis: Callers explicitly choose all three supported constraint-family data sets, bounded pass/iteration budgets, whether early exit is enabled, and the convergence tolerances used to skip redundant passes.

continuity.basis: The donor core and existing constraint capabilities are reused without replacement; distance limits join the established composer contract additively.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The optimization skips work only after positional and constrained-velocity residual checks pass, while slack limit interiors contribute no false residual and unresolved or conflicting constraints retain the bounded budget.
